title: Enterprise Intake: Clarity Canvas and Lightweight Scope
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Goal: Create a lightweight, repeatable 'Clarity Canvas' artifact used by Sales/CS to consolidate enterprise feature asks and produce an initial scoping packet that engineers and product can act on within one week. This ticket builds the template, training checklist, and a short runbook for rapid first-pass feasibility and cost ballparking.

Why: Sales and CS regularly surface large, multi-faceted asks that are stalled in back-and-forth. We need a common language and minimal artifact so PM/Eng can make a fast go/no-go and return a well-scoped next step with clear assumptions.

Scope:
- Design a single-page Clarity Canvas (problem statement, success metrics, affected workloads, compliance constraints, sample prompts/workflows, rough traffic & latency expectations, data residency, and must-have vs nice-to-have list).
- Create a one-page scoping packet template that includes initial engineering checklist (estimated tokens/session, expected concurrency, storage needs), cost heuristics (using Redwood Optimize guidance), and suggested rollout strategy (canary, pilot customers, fallback model).
- Produce a 30-minute training guide for Sales/CS (slides + script) and a Slack shortcut template that populates the canvas into #pm-intake.
- Define acceptance criteria and escalation points for items that require architecture/infra spikes (e.g., private deployment, HSM/KMS constraints, strict latency SLOs).

Out of scope: Full engineering spike to build the feature, legal contract changes, custom SLA negotiation. Those will be gated by the output of this canvas and a follow-up ticket if 'Go' is decided.

Trade-offs considered:
- Depth vs speed: the canvas must be minimal to avoid friction, but contain enough context for meaningful feasibility.
- Standardization vs account nuance: template will have optional fields for account-specific compliance notes rather than bespoke forms.

Acceptance criteria:
- Template deployed in Confluence and linked in the Sales playbook.
- Two Sales/CS reps run the canvas on live incoming asks in the pilot week and provide feedback.
- Engineering can produce a ballpark E2E cost estimate and list of 2-3 technical blockers within 5 business days of receiving a completed canvas.

Decision points:
1) If estimated cost > 3x our expected per-account ROI heuristic, recommend declining or re-negotiating scope with the account.
2) If the request requires private deployment or HSM within first release, flag for architecture review and escalate to a dedicated discovery ticket.

Deliverables:
- Confluence page: Clarity Canvas template + examples (pilot with AcmeCorp and OrbisAI).
- One-page scoping packet template (PDF/Drive).
- Sales training slide deck and 30-minute facilitator script.
- Slack message template and a short Loom demo.
acceptance_criteria: Clarity Canvas template published to Confluence with 2 completed example canvases
Sales/CS pilot: 2 reps complete canvas on live asks and submit feedback form
Engineering provides ballpark feasibility + cost estimate within 5 business days for pilot cases
